r: support.message: General support is outside this tracker's scope. If a patch isn't working as expected, please open a bug report.

r: app-side.message: This also happens in the unpatched app. If the patched app behaves differently, please describe the difference below.

r: not-this-bundle.message: This APK wasn't patched with this bundle. Please try patching it with this bundle in Morphe Manager or morphe-cli, and report again if the problem persists.

r: app-updated.message: This app version isn't supported yet. This issue is kept open to track support; please use a listed version for now.

r: server-side.message: This restriction comes from the app's server and can't be changed by patching the APK.

r: no-repro.message: This hasn't been reproduced yet. Please add the exact steps and the patch list from the app's entry in Morphe Manager.

r: fixed.message: The fix will be included in the next release. Update and repatch once it's available; please comment below if the problem persists.

r: not-a-bug.message: Closing because this doesn't appear to be a patch bug. Please comment with any details that suggest otherwise.

r: shipped.message: This is included in {latest_release}. Update the bundle in Morphe Manager and repatch.
